rules.statement: The Court has no discretion to add a party after judgment under Section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 18 contemplates the adding of parties before judgment. It allows the plaintiff or defendant to apply on or before the hearing 'to add a party'; but it says that the Court may 'at any time' order any party to be added. This means before final judgment."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code.
